evals.name: appian-task-reads-reference
evals.prompt: Open https://example.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/orders, click the 'New Order' button, and confirm the form opens.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads references/appian-sail.md before interacting, resolves the button position fresh right before clicking, and verifies the result in the DOM.
expectations: Agent reads browser-harness/references/appian-sail.md before the first click
Agent resolves the button position via the accessibility tree, getBoundingClientRect, or a DOM query rather than guessing from a screenshot
Agent re-queries the element position immediately before the click
Agent verifies the form opened with a DOM or page_info check, not only a screenshot

evals.name: non-appian-task-skips-reference
evals.prompt: Use the browser to open https://news.ycombinator.com, log which story is first, and report its title.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses browser-harness without loading the Appian reference.
expectations: Agent completes the task with new_tab and page content extraction

evals.name: appian-click-does-nothing-escalation
evals.prompt: On the Appian interface already open in my browser, I clicked 'Submit' and nothing seems to happen. Check whether the button is actually broken.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the escalation order: re-resolve and retry, direct DOM .click(), then stacked evidence (MutationObserver, network, text diff) before calling it a defect.
expectations: Agent retries with a freshly resolved coordinate click first
Agent then tries a direct DOM .click() via js(...)
Agent attaches a MutationObserver or checks network activity before the click
Agent does not report a defect based only on a before/after screenshot comparison

evals.name: appian-typing-verified
evals.prompt: In the Appian form open in my browser, fill the 'Customer name' field with 'Acme Corp' and click Next.
evals.expected_output: The agent types with real input events (not by setting .value), then reads the value back from the DOM before clicking Next.
expectations: Agent focuses the field and types with real keystrokes or Input.insertText
Agent does not set .value directly and dispatch a synthetic input event as the only input method
Agent reads the field's value back from the DOM before clicking Next
